source: Samsung ELEC RANGE Service Manual (30" Slide-In Self-Cleaning Electric Range, model code NSE6D*8100****)
content: Wi-Fi Connection is not working 1. Check whether Wi-Fi icon shown. 2. If the Wi-Fi icon is not displayed, register the range to SmartThings app by referring to the following instructions. 3. Make sure that the mobile phone is connected to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network. 4. Do not use the hidden AP in the wireless router settings during the device registration. 5. Use a unique SSID consisting of the alphabetic letters and the numeric digits without any blank. 6. For Wi-Fi security protocols, WPA2-PSK_AES is recommended. 7. Press time key and back key for 3 sec. (Long press) 8. If network version is shown normally, try to use SMART CONTROL feature again.

metadata.solution:
1. Check whether Wi-Fi icon shown.
2. If the Wi-Fi icon is not displayed, register the range to SmartThings app by referring to the following instructions.
3. Make sure that the mobile phone is connected to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network.
4. Do not use the hidden AP in the wireless router settings during the device registration.
5. Use a unique SSID consisting of the alphabetic letters and the numeric digits without any blank.
6. For Wi-Fi security protocols, WPA2-PSK_AES is recommended.
7. Press time key and back key for 3 sec. (Long press)
8. If network version is shown normally, try to use SMART CONTROL feature again.
